inventory_movements_reason_required.name: inventory_movements_reason_required
inventory_movements_reason_required.value:
"inventory_movements"."movement_type" NOT IN ('adjustment', 'write_off')
        OR nullif(trim("inventory_movements"."reason"), '') IS NOT NULL

physical_units_retirement_consistent.name: physical_units_retirement_consistent
physical_units_retirement_consistent.value:
("physical_units"."status" = 'retired' AND "physical_units"."retired_at" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("physical_units"."status" <> 'retired' AND "physical_units"."retired_at" IS NULL)

stock_policies_returnable_consistent.name: stock_policies_returnable_consistent
stock_policies_returnable_consistent.value:
(
        "stock_policies"."return_required"
        AND "stock_policies"."borrower_required"
        AND "stock_policies"."default_loan_days" IS NOT NULL
      ) OR (
        NOT "stock_policies"."return_required"
        AND NOT "stock_policies"."borrower_required"
        AND "stock_policies"."default_loan_days" IS NULL
      )
